svg.title: Of every 100 web requests each month: how many from v6 addresses, on open devices, and both
svg.desc: Three lines by month, each a count out of 100 requests: from v6 addresses, in orange; on open devices, dashed; and both at once, dashed orange. The complements, v4 addresses and closed devices, are each 100 minus the line drawn. Source: Cloudflare Radar.
svg.text: Of every 100 web requests, each month

text.tspan: Orange is v6 addresses. Dashed is open devices. Dashed orange is both at once: open devices
